Nearest Cross Street: Monmouth County Route No. 520
Subject to: Approx Upset Price - $929,312.41

Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal lien or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
